card.name: Spots before an X, x or hyphen
card.fires_on: Words or digits right before a hyphen, slash or multiplication sign that is followed by another item. Examples are 'X' in X-rays, a digit inside an ISBN or dose figure, and 'mid' before a hyphen.

modes.label: X in X-ray
modes.description: The letter X that begins X-rays or X-ray after a word like soft or chest.
modes.example: The origin of the soft<< X>>-rays is not clear at present.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit within an ISBN or a dose or formula figure, just before a hyphen or x sign.

modes.label: Word before a joiner
modes.description: A unit or term right before a slash or hyphen, such as min, toxicity or mid.

card.writes: It boosts a following X or similar joiner-plus-letter token, with no clear meaning beyond that.
card.plain: It fires on a word or number just before a hyphen, slash or times sign, most often in X-ray.
